chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan woman about 40, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, mustard-yellow trench coat over a black turtleneck, small gold hoop earrings
chars.SON: SON: a Moroccan teenage boy about 15, short curly black hair, bright red hoodie with white drawstrings, black backpack
chars.MAN: MAN: a Moroccan man about 45, neat short grey beard, round glasses, navy blazer over a white shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. MOM stepping out of a red Moroccan petit taxi in front of a cafe terrace on a busy Moroccan city street at dusk, glancing around nervously over her shoulder, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing, seen from across the street as if through a windshield. Calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. Inside the back seat of a Moroccan petit taxi, SON leans forward, eyes fixed ahead through the windshield, tensely handing crumpled banknotes to the driver (driver seen only from behind). Head-to-waist framing, face visible, determined and worried.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. SON crouches behind a parked white car on a Moroccan street at dusk, peeking over the hood toward a cafe terrace far across the street, face visible, wide anxious eyes. The cafe is small in the distance.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. Seen from a distance across the street, MOM sits at a small table on a Moroccan cafe terrace with MAN, two glasses of mint tea on the table, she is smiling shyly, he is leaning in talking. Both faces visible, warm cafe lights, evening.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. SON pressed against a wall at the corner of a Moroccan street, half hidden, holding his breath, clutching his backpack strap, afraid of being seen, face visible, dramatic evening light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. Close shot of SON's face and shoulders, hurt and confused, eyes glassy, jaw tight, a blurred cafe with warm lights behind him. Emotional teenage jealousy.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. SON in the foreground seen from the side, fists clenched, tears in his eyes, watching; in the blurred background across the street MOM laughs with MAN at the cafe table. Son's face visible.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. Over-the-shoulder view from behind a red hoodie in the foreground edge: across the street at the cafe terrace, MOM and MAN lean close to each other over the small table, he reaches toward her hand, she looks down smiling. Faces visible, evening lights.
